title: Fibroid removal
what: The surgeon removes fibroids, which are non-cancerous lumps in the wall of the womb, and keeps the womb itself. Most often this is done through small cuts in the belly, or through the vagina with no cuts.
why: For large fibroids, heavy and long periods, pain, pressure on the bladder, or when planning a pregnancy.
duration: surgery usually takes 1 to 3 hours; the hospital stay is usually 1 to 5 days
tell_doctor: All your medicines, especially blood thinners and hormones. The doctor will tell you what to stop and when
Heart or lung disease, diabetes, or anemia
If you have had belly surgery before
If you are planning a pregnancy
If you or your relatives ever had problems with anesthesia

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: Blood tests, swabs, an ECG, and an ultrasound. Your clinic will give you the list.

prepare.title: Type of surgery
prepare.text: The doctor will tell you how the fibroids will be removed: through small cuts, through the vagina, or through a larger cut. It depends on their size and where they are.

prepare.title: Anesthesiologist
prepare.text: Before surgery, an anesthesiologist will talk with you. Tell them about your health and medicines.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Usually no food from the evening before, and no drinks for a few hours before. Sometimes the bowel is cleared the day before, as your clinic instructs.

bring: Things for a few days in hospital
steps: On the day of surgery, you change into a gown and an IV is put into a vein
In the operating room, the anesthesiologist gives the anesthetic, and you fall asleep
The surgeon removes the fibroids using the chosen method
The wall of the womb is stitched
You wake up in the recovery room, and then you are moved to a regular ward
feel: Pain low in the belly and where the small cuts are. You will get pain relief
After keyhole surgery your shoulder often hurts. This is from the gas and passes in 1 to 2 days
Light bleeding for a few days is normal
after: You are usually allowed to get up and walk the same day or the next day
No heavy lifting for a few weeks
No sex, sauna, or swimming pool. The doctor will tell you for how long
The removed fibroids are sent to a lab. Discuss the result with your doctor
If you plan a pregnancy, the doctor will tell you after how many months it is safe
red_flags: A temperature above 38 degrees, or strong belly pain, or pain that keeps getting worse
Redness or pus at the stitches

faq.q: Can I get pregnant after fibroid removal?
faq.a: Often yes. This is one of the goals of the surgery. You are usually advised to wait a few months so the scar on the womb can heal.
Yes, sometimes new ones appear. That is why you need regular check-ups with a gynecologist after surgery.

reminders.text: Surgery tomorrow. Pack your things, ID, and medicine list. Eat and drink only until the times your clinic gave you.
